There are n  stars in the sky, which can be regarded as points on a plane with Cartesian coordinates. The coordinates of the i -th star are (xi,yi) . It is guaranteed that all x1,x2,…,xn  are pairwise distinct, and all y1,y2,…,yn  are pairwise distinct. The stars are numbered from 1  to n  in the order they are given in the input.  Funni-chan wants to connect some pairs of these stars to form a constellation.  She defines the basic unit of a constellation as a triangle formed by three stars connected pairwise. A triangle is called harmonious if there exists an axis-aligned rectangle such that all three vertices of the triangle lie on the boundary of the rectangle.  Funni-chan imposes the following constraints on the constellation:  Every triangle in the constellation must be harmonious. The interiors of any two triangles in the constellation must be disjoint. Note that the boundary of a triangle is not considered part of its interior. Under these constraints, Funni-chan wants her constellation to contain the maximum possible number of triangles. Your task is to find this maximum number and construct a valid constellation that achieves it.  DeepL 翻译       趣子喜欢看星星。  天空中有 n  颗星星，它们可以看作是平面上的点，具有笛卡尔坐标。第 i  颗星星的坐标是 (xi,yi)  。保证所有 x1,x2,…,xn  都是成对不同的，所有 y1,y2,…,yn  都是成对不同的。星号按照输入中给出的顺序从 1  到 n  依次编号。  Funni-chan 希望将这些星星中的某些对连接起来组成一个星座。  她将星座的基本单位定义为由三颗星成对连接而成的三角形。如果存在一个轴对齐的矩形，且三角形的三个顶点都位于矩形的边界上，那么这个三角形就称为和谐三角形。  Funni-chan 对星座施加了以下限制：  星座中的每个三角形必须和谐。 星座中任意两个三角形的内部必须互不相交。请注意，三角形的边界不被视为其内部的一部分。 在这些限制条件下，Funni-chan 希望她的星座包含尽可能多的三角形。您的任务就是找到这个最大数量，并构建一个有效的星座来实现它。        Input Each test contains multiple test cases.
